steps.prompt: The rim reaches you on your wall. What did you see before it got there?

options.text: Their LW and their LD coming down my wall
options.fb: Right. You were stopped and made a shoulder check before the puck came. You know who is coming and from where, so you choose while the puck is still on its way.

options.text: Only the puck coming along the boards
options.fb: Being stopped wins the puck. But you watched only the puck, so you find their LW and their LD after it lands. That half second was your time to carry it.

options.text: Nothing yet, I was still skating to my wall
options.fb: The rim hits you while you move. You take it on your skates with your back to the play, and their LD pinches while you are still turning.

options.text: Their C chasing our RD behind the net
options.fb: Their C is behind you now, chasing our RD. The danger is in front: their LW coming down the wall and their LD leaving the point.

steps.prompt: You have the puck. Their LD pinches down your wall, but late. What do you do?

options.text: Carry it up the wall past their LD
options.fb: Right. Their LD came late, so the wall is still open. You go past them with speed, and three of us attack their two defenders: a 3-on-2.

options.text: Chip it off the glass past their LD
options.fb: Safe, but you give away a puck you could carry. Chip it only when their LD has fully committed and our C is coming through the middle. Here it becomes a race.

options.text: Pass it back to our RD behind the net
options.fb: Their C is right there, chasing the puck. It goes back into the forecheck, and the breakout starts again in our corner.

options.text: Pass it across to our C in the middle
options.fb: The pass goes through their C and their LW. If they take it in the middle of our zone, they shoot at our net.

steps.prompt: Their LD is pinching late. Tap where you should be.

fb.right: Up the wall with the puck and moving, beside their LW, before their LD reaches you.
fb.close: On the wall, but a stride or two back. Their LW is still beside you and their LD is closer.
fb.wrong: Still at the hash marks, or off the wall. Their LW is above you, and their LD arrives while you stand still.
